_: Counters that may only DECREASE. Replaces editable allowlists: an allowlist grows monotonically, a ratchet shrinks. Recompute with the commands in _commands. See .local/final-review/05-quality-gates.md.

_commands.untaggedRunGracePaths: grep -c 'isWithinUntaggedGraceWindow(run.createdAt)' src/shared/jobs/owned-run.ts   # removed; every payload carries a project id, so every run is tagged
_commands.routesTakingProjectIdWithoutOwnershipChe: for f in $(find src/app/api -name route.ts); do grep -qE 'projectId|project_id' "$f" && ! grep -rqE 'projectScope|episodeScope|beatScope|characterScope|withProjectScope|verifyProjectAccess|verifyEpisodeAccess|verifyBeatAccess|verifyCharacterAccess|verifyProjectOwnership|listForUser|session\.user\.id|isAdminUser' "$(dirname "$f")" && echo "$f"; done | wc -l
_commands.sessionExistenceOnlyRoutes: grep -rl 'auth-scope: session-existence-only' src/app/api --include='*.ts' | wc -l   # each is a reviewed decision; the number should not grow
_commands.directDbClientImporters: grep -rln "from '@/db/client'|from '@/db'" src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -v __tests__ | grep -v shared/persistence | wc -l
_commands.serviceRoleClientSites: grep -rln 'createSupabaseServiceClient()|supabaseAdmin' src --include='*.ts' | grep -v __tests__ | grep -v shared/persistence | wc -l   # each must move to serviceRoleClient(reason)
_commands.providerSdkImportsOutsideGateway: npx vitest run scripts/__tests__/provider-sdk-inventory.test.ts   # length of REMAINDER in eslint-rules/provider-sdk-exemptions.js; each entry is a named gap. Gate A2 is error everywhere else.
_commands.langChainImports: same test   # SPEC-13 removes LangChain entirely; target 0
_commands.bareProcessEnvReads: npx vitest run scripts/__tests__/process-env-inventory.test.ts   # SPEC-12 burns this to 0
_commands.processEnvReadsInModelConfig: same test   # cleared 2026-08-28 by SPEC-13 Task 13; the model-config files read from @/shared/config/env like everything else
_commands.bareProjectIdExports: npx eslint src 2>&1 | grep -c 'no-bare-project-id-param'   # reached 0; the rule is now 'error', so this stays 0 by construction
_commands.systemScopeSites: grep -rn 'systemScope(' src --include='*.ts' | grep -v __tests__ | grep -v project-scope.ts | wc -l   # background jobs billing a model with no user behind them; each names a SystemScopeReason
_commands.rawTaskDefinitions: npx vitest run scripts/__tests__/trigger-task-inventory.test.ts   # `task(`/`schemaTask(` outside shared/jobs/define-task.ts; SPEC-14 takes this to 0
_commands.tasksWithoutQueue: same test   # a *.task.ts with no `queue:`; the factory makes queue required, so 0 is structural
_commands.tasksWithoutIdempotencyKey: same test   # trigger calls bypassing triggerOwnedRun, the only caller that derives a key from the submission nonce
_commands.triggerSdkV3Imports: same test   # files importing '@trigger.dev/sdk/v3'; CLAUDE.md mandates the v4 entrypoint
